rules.primary_stage2_set: Stage-1 failures whose first_error_verdict == CONFIRM. Items with DISAGREE/UNCLEAR are excluded from Stage 2 entirely (all conditions, so pairing is preserved); a reviewer-suggested alternative step is recorded but NEVER used to re-point L_true/N_true.
rules.l_false: Built only for primary-set items whose false_step_verdict == CORRECT; otherwise the item is ineligible ONLY for L_false.
rules.l_false_A6: Since A6: built for primary-set items whose false_step_verdict is in l_false_eligible_verdicts (CORRECT or PASS1_IMPLIED); with the Pass-1-only review every CONFIRM item is PASS1_IMPLIED.
rules.below_min: If fewer than min_primary_items items pass review, STOP and report (Stage-2 build needs an explicit researcher override).
